Martial arts-trained bystander stepped in

Dispute over knife allegations

Democratic congressional candidate Kirill Basin appeared in a Maui courtroom in handcuffs on Tuesday after allegedly threatening people at a beach before being knocked unconscious by a trained bystander.The 40-year-old, who is running for Hawaii's 2nd Congressional District, was remanded in custody on two counts of first-degree terroristic threatening following a weekend incident at Keawakapu Beach in South Kihei.A judge in Wailuku kept his bail at $1 million despite objections from defence lawyer Brandon Segal, who called the amount "outrageous.""These are just allegations. My client has a presumption of innocence," Segal told reporters.According to the Maui Police Department, the incident began outside the Mana Kai Maui hotel when a 61-year-old man asked Basin to lower the volume of his loud music.Police said Basin responded by suggesting he had a gun and threatening to shoot the man's wife.Video of the incident obtained by Hawaii News Now shows Basin becoming increasingly angry, shouting at people nearby and swinging a beach chair before being knocked to the ground.The man who intervened, construction worker and mixed martial arts practitioner Kama Homan, told Hawaii News Now he stepped in after hearing Basin threaten older women on the beach."I’m like, maybe I should intervene, and then as I got closer and closer, he was just getting more irate and violent and then saying stuff. ‘I’m going to hurt you’ or ‘I can injure you’ or ‘You like scrap’ to the aunties," Kama told the broadcaster.The situation quickly turned physical when Basin approached him."He put his hands on me and as soon as he tried to shove me, I hit him with a left and a right and that’s when he stumbled and fell over the chairs," Kama said. He added that he kept defending himself after Basin swung a beach chair at his head. "Just block it and go for the KO. Just protect myself, which is why I had my hand up and then I adjusted to block the chair."Kama knocked Basin unconscious with two punches. He later said he had no idea Basin was running for Congress and explained his actions by saying: "You do what’s right because that’s what we should do and that’s my whole motto in life."Police said Basin also pulled out a knife during the incident, threatened several people and then threw the weapon into the ocean.Kama said the weapon was a five-inch switchblade, which he recovered from the water and handed over to police."He ended up pulling the knife out on me after the altercation and that was obviously a game changer when I knew he was off," Kama told Hawaii News Now.Defence lawyer Segal strongly challenged the knife allegations in court, arguing that videos of the incident do not support the claims."There’s no evidence in any of these videos that have been circulated tremendously that he ever had a knife in his possession. He never had a firearm in his possession," Segal said.Court records show Basin has previously been arrested in cases involving assault and property damage, including an incident in May in which he allegedly pointed a firearm during an argument with county workers.After Tuesday's hearing, the court ordered Basin to undergo a formal mental health evaluation.
Article Summary: Democratic congressional candidate Kirill Basin appeared in a Maui courtroom in handcuffs on Tuesday. He was remanded in custody on two counts of first-degree terroristic threatening following a weekend incident at Keawakapu Beach in South Kihei. The man who intervened, construction worker and mixed martial arts practitioner Kama Homan, said he had no idea Basin was running for Congress.

Article Title: Vance over Rubio for 2028? What Trump reportedly told donors at private meeting
Article Text:
What Trump told donors at private meeting in White House

How midterms hold the key

Where Rubio stands

(With ANI inputs)

US President Donald Trump told donors at a private meeting that "we need to elect JD," weighing in on Vice President JD Vance as the Republican Party's presidential candidate for the 2028 election, according to The Washington Post.The remarks were reportedly made during a meeting at the White House around two weeks ago."At the end of the day, we need to elect JD," Trump said, according to two people with knowledge of the comments who spoke on the condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to discuss the matter.However, the report also noted that Trump's remark does not mean he has settled on a preferred candidate, as he continues to weigh both Vance and secretary of state Marco Rubio "Anyone assuming it's a lock is just getting way ahead of themselves, or just doesn't know the president very well," an official was quoted as saying.As a two-term president, Trump is constitutionally barred from seeking another term. However, he has repeatedly spoken about "running" for a third term.Vance, meanwhile, has not confirmed his plans. People who have spoken to him about the matter told The Washington Post earlier this year that he had not yet made a decision.One person close to him said the vice president would put off any decision until after the birth of his fourth child, who was born on July 19.In June, Vance told CBS News that he would discuss the matter with his wife Usha after the midterm elections but had "no doubt that the president of the United States is going to be very supportive" of whatever decision he makes. He has repeatedly maintained that he is focused on his current role and is "good friends" with Rubio.The report added that the prospect of a succession battle has already created tensions within the Republican Party, with donors, activists and party figures lining up for or against Vance.It noted that much depends on the midterm elections. A poor Republican performance could encourage challengers to contest Trump's preferred candidate and criticise his administration. Both Vance and Rubio could face intraparty attacks that Republicans would be unlikely to direct at Trump himself.According to The Washington Post, Rubio had the backing of many pre-Trump Republican donors during the 2024 vice-presidential selection process, while Vance drew support from the younger MAGA coalition that helped return Trump to power in 2024. As vice president, Vance has also cultivated ties with party donors to raise funds for the GOP.The report also noted that Rubio avoids discussing the 2028 race and has recently reduced his media appearances to avoid questions about it, according to a person close to him. However, his media team briefly fuelled speculation earlier this year by releasing a widely shared video of him delivering a campaign-style monologue during a press briefing.In internal conversations, Rubio has indicated that he intends to serve out his term, the person added. He does not have a campaign organisation in place.The report also quoted a Trump adviser as saying that the president would like to see Vance-Rubio joint ticket and regularly praises the secretary of state. However, it remains unclear whether Rubio would be willing to serve as Vance's running mate.
Article Summary: US President Donald Trump told donors at a private meeting that "we need to elect JD," weighing in on Vice President JD Vance as the Republican Party's presidential candidate for the 2028 election. The remarks were reportedly made during a meeting at the White House around two weeks ago. Trump is constitutionally barred from seeking another term.

Article Title: Rebecca DePaula was an NYPD officer, pastor and mother of three; her family is demanding an investigation after she died following surgery in the Dominican Republic
Article Text:
Rebecca De Paula.Photo credit : NYPD 46 Precinct/Facebook

What actually happened

A young officer remembered

Why the family is asking questions

What is known so far

A loss beyond the badge

Rebecca DePaula, a 31-year-old NYPD officer, wife, mother of three and pastor, has died in the Dominican Republic after complications following cosmetic surgery. Her family is now asking for an investigation into whether negligence or improper medical procedures played a role in her death, as per reports.DePaula had served with the NYPD for only about 18 months and worked out of the 46th Precinct in the Fordham section of the Bronx. Colleagues and the city’s Dominican officers’ community are mourning her loss, remembering her as a committed officer and a devoted family woman.According to reports from Dominican media cited by U.S. outlets, DePaula traveled to the Dominican Republic for a procedure to remove her breast implants. Local reporting says she developed a bacterial infection after the surgery, and her condition worsened before she died at a clinic in Santo Domingo, according to a report by PEOPLE.Her family has reportedly asked authorities to look into whether proper safety protocols were followed. They also want to know whether negligence contributed to the fatal outcome. The investigation is still ongoing, and officials have not publicly identified the clinic where the procedure took place."She felt she had to have it removed because it bothered her...The surgery here is very expensive. There, they do it cheaper, and look at the consequences," Elena Santana, her friend, told CBS News New York in Spanish.DePaula’s death has hit the NYPD community hard because she was just beginning her career. She joined the force in January 2025 and, according to reports, was named the 46th Precinct’s officer of the month in March.The New York Dominican Officers Organization posted a tribute calling her death a “tremendous loss.” In its message, the group said DePaula’s kindness, service and memory would not be forgotten and asked people to keep her family in their thoughts and prayers.New York City Police Benevolent Association President Patrick Hendry also called the death a tragedy, saying the department had lost “our sister P.O. Rebecca DePaula” after only 18 months on the job.The family’s request for an investigation reflects a wider concern about medical tourism and cosmetic procedures abroad. While many people travel overseas for lower-cost surgeries, such procedures can carry added risks, including infection and complications during recovery.In DePaula’s case, relatives want to know whether the clinic followed the right standards and whether anything could have been done differently, as per reports. That question has become even more urgent because the reports point to a bacterial infection as the complication that led to her death.As of the latest reports, Dominican authorities are still investigating the circumstances of her death. Her remains are expected to be transferred to the United States for burial after forensic review is complete.The exact clinic and surgeon involved have not been publicly confirmed. U.S. outlets, including NBC New York and PEOPLE, have relied on Dominican reporting and family statements as the situation continues to develop.DePaula was more than an officer. Reports describe her as a pastor and a mother whose family life was central to her identity. That makes her death feel especially painful for those who knew her, because it cuts across so many roles at once: public servant, parent, spouse and spiritual leader.For her coworkers and family, the tragedy is not only that she died young, but that she had only recently begun building a life and career in the NYPD. For now, the questions surrounding her death remain unanswered, and her loved ones are waiting for clarity.What are your views on this incident? Tell us about it in the comments section below.
Article Summary: Rebecca DePaula, a 31-year-old NYPD officer, wife, mother of three and pastor, has died in the Dominican Republic after complications following cosmetic surgery. Her family is now asking for an investigation into whether negligence or improper medical procedures played a role in her death, as per reports. She had served with the NYPD for only about 18 months.

Article Title: 2024 Sambhal violence: Panel traces communal clashes back to 1930s, calls town among UP's most sensitive
Article Text:
Following a court-ordered survey, a judicial commission delved into the violence in Sambhal





LUCKNOW: A substantial portion of the report, tabled by the judicial commission constituted by the Uttar Pradesh govt to probe Sambhal violence in 2024, focuses on Sambhal’s history and the disputed mosque site.The commission noted that Sambhal has long been regarded as a religiously significant town and is associated in Hindu tradition with Kalki, the future incarnation of Lord Vishnu.The report cites historical records and gazetteers describing the existence of the Harihar Mandir at the site where the Shahi Jama Masjid now stands.Referring to historical records, the commission said that the mosque is believed to have been constructed in 1526 during Babur’s reign and is a centrally protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).The structure has enjoyed protected status since 1920 under heritage conservation laws.The report said that ASI officials faced resistance during an inspection conducted in June 2024 and alleged that certain structural modifications had been made to the monument over time.The commission clarified that the question of whether the mosque was constructed over the ruins of a temple remains the subject matter of the pending civil suit and that no findings were recorded on that issue.The commission traced multiple episodes of communal violence in Sambhal from the 1930s onwards, including riots in 1947, 1948, 1958, 1962, 1976, 1978, 1980, 1986, 1990, 1992, 1995 and during the anti-CAA protests in 2019.According to the report, Sambhal has repeatedly witnessed Hindu-Muslim clashes and periodic communal unrest, making it one of the most sensitive towns in UP from a law-and-order perspective.The report referred to long-standing rivalries among influential Muslim groups and political factions in the district, which it said contributed to local tensions.Conducting one of the most extensive inquiries, the commission visited Sambhal shortly after the violence, inspected Jama Masjid and surrounding areas and held multiple rounds of hearings in Lucknow, Sambhal and through video conferencing.In all, 199 witnesses were examined, including 29 police personnel, 12 administrative officials, 19 medical professionals, 34 civilian witnesses, 78 detainees linked to the violence, media personnel, members of the Jama Masjid management committee, complainants, forensic experts and political figures.The commission reviewed FIRs, medical reports, postmortem records, forensic reports, ballistic evidence, CCTV footage, media recordings, drone footage and affidavits submitted by witnesses.According to the report, the controversy began on Nov 19, 2024, when Hari Shankar Jain and seven others filed original suit before the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Chandausi.The same day, the court allowed an application seeking appointment of an advocate commissioner to conduct a survey of the disputed site and directed that photography and videography be undertaken during the exercise.Advocate Ramesh Chandra Raghav was appointed survey commissioner and approached the Sambhal district administration for security arrangements.The first phase of the survey began on Nov 19 but could not be completed that day because of fading daylight and growing opposition from local political figures and supporters.The report said that when the remaining survey was conducted on Nov 24, thousands gathered around the mosque to oppose the exercise.Police and administrative officers repeatedly informed the crowd that the survey was being conducted under court orders, but tensions escalated. Stone pelting, arson and firing broke out, leading to clashes with security personnel.Police responded with tear gas shells, chilli grenades, rubber bullets, pump-action guns and other crowd-control measures.The violence left four people dead and several police personnel injured.The state govt constituted a judicial commission comprising Justice (retd) Devendra Kumar Arora as chairman, retired IAS officer Amit Mohan Prasad and retired DGP Arvind Kumar Jain as members.
Article Summary: Sambhal has long been regarded as a religiously significant town. The mosque is believed to have been constructed in 1526 during Babur’s reign. It is a centrally protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) The structure has enjoyed protected status since 1920 under heritage conservation laws.

Article Title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif arrives in Saudi Arabia, pushes defence ties amid West Asia escalation
Article Text:
The trip follows Saudi Arabia’s proposal last week for a Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition

Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on Thursday for a three-day official visit, accompanied by Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir and a high-level delegation, as Islamabad seeks to reinforce its strategic partnership with Riyadh amid escalating tensions across West Asia and the Gulf region.Sharif was received at King Abdulaziz International Airport by Prince Saud bin Mishaal bin Abdulaziz, Deputy Governor of the Makkah Region, along with other senior Saudi officials.The delegation includes Defence Minister Khawaja Asif, Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Special Assistant Tariq Fatemi. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, who concluded a visit to Jordan earlier this week, is expected to join the delegation in Saudi Arabia.The visit comes as the conflict in West Asia has widened across multiple fronts, including the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, prompting Gulf states to strengthen regional security coordination and safeguard vital maritime routes and energy supply corridors.During the August 6 to 8 visit, Sharif is scheduled to meet Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman. According to Pakistan’s Foreign Office (FO), the discussions will focus on strengthening bilateral ties and coordinating on regional and international issues.“During the visit, the prime minister will meet Crown Prince and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia Mohammed bin Salman. Discussions would focus on consolidating the Pakistan-Saudi bilateral relationship and exchange views on areas of regional and international developments of mutual interests,” the FO said in a statement.The FO described the visit as a reflection of Pakistan’s long-standing partnership with Saudi Arabia, built on decades of mutual trust, cooperation and brotherhood.“Although taking place amid heightened tensions in the Gulf, the visit carries significance beyond the immediate crisis and short-term considerations. It will further strengthen bilateral relations, deepen strategic cooperation, enhance coordination on regional and international issues of mutual interest and also reinforce multilateral cooperation,” the FO said.The trip follows Saudi Arabia’s proposal last week for a Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition aimed at protecting commercial shipping lanes and critical energy routes through the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandeb Strait after attacks on Saudi-linked vessels by Iran-backed Houthi forces in Yemen. Fourteen countries, including Pakistan, expressed support for the initiative.Islamabad also reiterated its commitment to Saudi Arabia’s security and emphasised the importance of ensuring the uninterrupted flow of lawful maritime commerce through the Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandeb.Pakistan and Saudi Arabia further strengthened their defence relationship last year by signing a Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement, which became operational earlier this year. Under the framework, Pakistan has deployed military personnel and aircraft to Saudi Arabia for joint training, defence cooperation and support for the kingdom’s security requirements.The visit also comes shortly after Pakistan said it was “doing its utmost” to bring the United States and Iran back to the negotiating table under the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding signed on 18 June, highlighting Islamabad’s attempt to balance its close ties with Riyadh while maintaining communication channels with Tehran.Saudi Arabia remains a key financial partner for Pakistan. According to a provisional foreign economic assistance report by Pakistan’s Ministry of Economic Affairs, Riyadh extended a fresh USD 3 billion deposit facility and rolled over an existing USD 5 billion facility for another three years in the 2025-26 financial year, providing critical support to Pakistan’s economy.
Article Summary: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on Thursday for a three-day official visit. He is accompanied by Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir and a high-level delegation. The trip follows Saudi Arabia’s proposal last week for a Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition.

Article Title: Bhiwandi crash: Buiding owner, repairs contractor booked; state orders probe
Article Text:
A five-storey Bhiwandi building collapsed, killing ten people and injuring three others

Hundreds of dangerous buildings in MMR, thousands at risk (Photo credit: Santosh Gupta)





MUMBAI: The state govt ordered an inquiry into the crash of a part of a five-storey Bhiwandi building that claimed 10 lives.An FIR was lodged against the contractor hired for repairs, Ashok, and building owner, Bilal Khan, under Sections 105 (culpable homicide not amounting to murder) and 125 (negligent act endangering human life or personal safety of others) of BNS and relevant provisions of Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act for illegal construction, said DCP (zone 2), Thane, Pawan Basod.The PM announced an ex gratia of Rs 2 lakh each for the families of those killed and the CM Rs 5 lakh each.This was the third such major building collapse in Bhiwandi since 2020.Repairs began four days earlier after residents flagged falling plaster chunks and hired a contractor on their own. The building was not vacated during the work.Around 8pm on Thursday, residents noticed that a supporting pillar in wing B had developed a crack and was tilting, alerted the contractor and vacated the building.Workers were immediately brought in and the pillar was reinforced with iron support rods. Assuming that the structure had been stabilised, many residents went back into the building around 11.30pm.Moments later, half the wing collapsed, trapping many residents and labourers under the rubble.Over the next 15 hours, NDRF, fire brigade and Thane disaster response force personnel pulled out the bodies of Rakesh Paswan (25), Mukesh Paswan (30), Ashok Paswan (40), Krish Kumar (32), Ranjit Singh (45), Radheshyam Kushwaha (45), Siraj Rasul Sheikh (45), Shamim Ansari (32), Shyam Pal (40), and Santosh Pandey (42).Those injured, Abhay Yadav (26), Deepak Yadav (25) and Sangeeta Prajapati (36), were taken to a hospital. Some residents were rescued from the portion of the wing that remained standing.An NDRF officer said the building suffered a “pancake collapse”, in which one floor falls directly onto another.“The chances of survival in such collapses are extremely low. We deployed trained sniffer dogs to locate the victims.”Disaster management minister Girish Mahajan, who visited the site, said the repairs were carried out late at night to escape civic scrutiny.He directed the authorities to ensure that all dangerous buildings in Bhiwandi are vacated and appropriate action.Mehtab Ansari, a resident, told TOI that all flat owners had contributed around Rs 10,000 each for the repairs.Another resident, Komal Arvind Gupta, alleged that negligence during the work damaged the pillar.
Article Summary: An FIR was lodged against the contractor hired for repairs, Ashok, and building owner, Bilal Khan, under Sections 105 (culpable homicide not amounting to murder) and 125 (negligent act endangering human life or personal safety of others) The PM announced an ex gratia of Rs 2 lakh each for the families of those killed.

Article Title: Canadian woman who slapped teen wearing pro-Trump clothing faces deportation
Article Text:
Kaitlyn Tracey

Confrontation over Trump and ICE clothing

Visa overstay led to immigration action

Husband sought support after ICE detention

A Canadian woman who admitted to slapping a teenager during a confrontation over pro-Trump clothing at the Jersey Shore has been ordered to be deported from the United States after pleading guilty to a misdemeanor assault charge.Kaitlyn Tracey, 33, pleaded guilty to one count of simple assault in connection with the July 3 incident on the boardwalk at Point Pleasant Beach, New Jersey.An immigration judge in Texas subsequently ordered her deportation to Canada after US authorities said she had overstayed her visa, the New York Post reported.Tracey was sentenced to one day in jail but received credit for time already served following her detention in Ocean County.According to police, Tracey approached a group of teenagers on the boardwalk after noticing clothing with pro-Trump political messaging.Investigators said an argument followed before she struck one teenage girl with an open hand, hitting her once on the body and once on the face. The incident was captured on surveillance video, police said.She was initially charged with simple assault, endangering the welfare of a child, harassment and obstruction.The assault charge was later resolved through her guilty plea.The US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said Tracey entered the US in April 2024 on a temporary visa that expired in September the same year and remained in the country unlawfully after it lapsed.A DHS spokesperson said Tracey "received full due process" before being ordered removed by an immigration judge and that Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) would return her to Canada "as soon as possible."Following her arrest, Tracey was transferred to ICE custody after an immigration detainer was lodged against her.Her husband, an American citizen, had appealed publicly for support, saying the couple had been married for more than three years and that he hoped she would be released, even if it meant returning to Canada.An online fundraiser launched to help cover Tracey's legal expenses reportedly raised less than half of its stated goal.A separate fundraising campaign was removed by GoFundMe after the platform said it violated policies related to fundraising for people accused of violent crimes.During sentencing, the judge read portions of a victim impact statement from the teenager's family, noting that they were grateful the incident had been captured on camera and looked forward to the case being resolved.The court indicated that Tracey's removal from the US is expected to prevent her return for a prolonged period.
Article Summary: Kaitlyn Tracey, 33, pleaded guilty to one count of simple assault in connection with the July 3 incident on the boardwalk at Point Pleasant Beach, New Jersey. She was sentenced to one day in jail but received credit for time already served following her detention in Ocean County. An immigration judge in Texas subsequently ordered her deportation to Canada after US authorities said she had overstayed her visa.

Article Title: Bangladesh Chalo: Defiant Hasina says will return, not afraid of jail or death
Article Text:
Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announced that she will return to her country

Holding her first public press conference since her ouster exactly two years ago, former Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina reiterated her determination to return to her country by the end of this year. Addressing virtually the media gathering in Delhi, Hasina provided her version of events that led her to flee Bangladesh. She asserted that a conspiracy had been hatched to misguide genuine students, who protested against her govt, leading to its dissolution.Highlighting the violent character of the 2024 upheaval, Hasina said that hundreds of offices belonging to her Awami League party were vandalised, houses of Awami leaders were burnt, policemen attacked and killed, and thousands of Awami supporters were assaulted and murdered. Yet, the Muhammad Yunus-led interim govt passed an indemnity ordinance, later converted into a law, to protect the violent protesters.“I, myself, had instituted a judicial inquiry commission to investigate all the cases of violence independently, so that the truth could be known. But after the Yunus regime seized power, they stopped the work of the commission. If they had nothing to hide, why would they prevent the inquiry?” said Hasina.Alleging continuing violence and persecution under the current BNP-led govt, Hasina said that at least 10,000 Awami leaders and workers have been killed or disappeared. “Many Awami leaders, intellectuals and workers also continue to languish in jail without due process or trial, and they have been subjected to torture and denial of their legal rights.”Hasina’s son and senior Awami leader, Sajeeb Wazed Joy, who also joined the press conference virtually from the US, stressed on the indemnity point. “None of the police killings, per the indemnity law, can be prosecuted. So, my question is this: Are killings acceptable? If you can have blanket immunity for protesters who killed police officers, killed civilians and Awami League members and leaders, then why blame anybody?”Joy added, “Bangladesh today is a failed state. There are no human rights, there is no freedom of speech. Political killings in Bangladesh, since August 2024, have been legalised.”Hasina also laid down her demands. “The ban on the Awami League must be lifted, political prisoners must be released, false cases must be dropped, freedom of speech must be restored, media freedom must be protected, and judicial independence must be guaranteed.” Asked about her return and the currentBangladeshi govt’s intention to arrest her if she does so, Hasina asserted, “I have been arrested many times in my political life. After returning to Bangladesh in 1981, I was arrested in 1983. Then again in 1985, 1987, even in 2007 they tried to stop my return when I was outside Bangladesh. But I returned. I know they might arrest me or even kill me. But my people support me and I have to be with them to save Bangladesh. I will not let fear dictate my life. ”
Article Summary: Sheikh Hasina announced that she will return to her country by the end of this year. She said that a conspiracy had been hatched to misguide genuine students. Hasina said that at least 10,000 Awami leaders and workers have been killed or disappeared.

Article Title: Watch: Zohran Mamdani booed at NYC pro-police event, leaves stage in less than a minute
Article Text:
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani.

Brief speech amid hostile reception

Protester collapses after trying to approach mayor

Event promotes police-community partnerships

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani was loudly booed by sections of the crowd during a National Night Out Against Crime event in Staten Island on Tuesday, forcing him to keep his remarks to less than a minute before leaving the stage.According to local media reports, Mamdani addressed thousands of attendees gathered at Midland Beach during the NYPD's 43rd National Night Out Against Crime celebration, an annual event aimed at strengthening police-community ties.Videos shared on social media showed people shouting at him to leave as he walked to the podium, while others gave him thumbs-down gestures.Despite the hostile reception, Mamdani smiled throughout his brief address."Happy Night Out Against Crime. It's amazing to be here for the Staten Island community," Mamdani told the crowd.He also thanked local officials and artist Scott LoBaido before concluding with, "God bless everyone. Thank you."His appearance lasted under a minute before he exited the stage. According to local reports, the mayor later stopped to pose for photographs with some attendees despite the vocal backlash.Shortly after Mamdani's remarks, Staten Island artist and activist Scott LoBaido suffered a cardiac arrest during the event.According to witnesses cited by local media, LoBaido had been part of a group hoping to question the mayor over his reported decision to halt a phased plan to add 5,000 NYPD officers.Witnesses said he attempted to approach Mamdani as the mayor left the stage but was stopped by officers.Soon afterward, LoBaido reportedly said he was feeling unwell, knelt down and collapsed. Emergency responders performed CPR and administered oxygen before taking him to hospital.Later that night, LoBaido posted on Facebook from hospital, indicating he was recovering.The National Night Out Against Crime was held at more than 70 locations across New York City on Tuesday. The annual initiative is designed to promote partnerships between police and local communities through family-friendly events featuring games, performances, food and community activities.NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch, who also attended the Staten Island event, thanked officers for their work and stressed the importance of cooperation between law enforcement, residents and elected officials in maintaining public safety.While Mamdani won New York City's 2025 mayoral election, Staten Island, the city's most Republican-leaning borough, overwhelmingly voted against him, contributing to the hostile reception he received on Tuesday.
Article Summary: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani was booed by sections of the crowd during a National Night Out Against Crime event in Staten Island on Tuesday. The annual event promotes partnerships between police and local communities through family- friendly events. Shortly after the mayor left the stage, an artist and activist suffered a cardiac arrest.

Article Title: Who is Sadhana Gollapudi? Row over Indian woman's dancing video as she's baselessly accused of visa fraud; attorney says she's US citizen
Article Text:
An Indian-American woman's dancing video was publicly shared and she was accused of visa fraud while US attorney confirmed Sadhana Gollapudi is a US citizen.

'Online witchhunts'

Who is Sadhana Gollapudi ?

In the wake of the anti-Indian wave in the US, several social media accounts have started targeting Indians living in the US and accusing them of visa fraud. Most often, these allegations are not based on any data; it's just pure slander and this time Sadhana Gollapudi, an Indian-American woman, became the target of such slander after a popular anti-Indian social media account posted a dancing video of Sadhana and claimed that she had been in the US on an F-1 visa since 2014.F-1 is a student visa on which she might have come to the country, but the account did not verify it and instead called her a "forever" student. "Sadhana enjoys traditional barefoot crab dancing in Houston, Texas. For 12 years, she has played the student visa game, enrolling in multiple programs. Works as a dancer & cash tutor violating her visa," the account said.US attorney Aaron Reitz responded to the claim and confirmed that Gollapudi is a naturalized US citizen which means she had her Green Card and then became a US citizen."Thanks for flagging. My office looked. She’s a naturalized US citizen, not here on student visa. As US Attorney over Houston, I take visa fraud seriously. We prosecute it to the fullest. Neither illegal aliens nor those who obtain legal status illegally are welcome on American soil," Reitz posted.The account that flagged the case did not apologize. "Thanks for looking into this matter. We have many serious visa fraud cases with detailed evidence that we can share with your office," it said.The incident triggered a massive backlash from the Indian-American community. Co-founder of the Indian American Advocacy Council Sidharth said he filed a formal complaint with the DOJ office of Professional Responsibility. "Taxpayer -unded federal power should protect innocent Americans—not legitimize online witch hunts and reward reckless smears," Sidharth wrote.Sidharth said that an American woman was falsely branded as a visa fraudster in front of 2.8 million people and faced no repercussions. "US Attorney @USAttyReitz invoked the authority of his office, confirmed she is a naturalized citizen, needlessly disclosed her citizenship status and then thanked the false accuser," Sidharth wrote.Hindu American Foundation executive director Suhag Shukla questioned attorney Reitz for responding to a racial hate post. "You actually responded to a racist/hateful post by a Pakistani actor stan account and investigated a US citizen performing classical Indian dance in front of her house," Shukla wrote."Did I miss the part where you apologized for investigating an innocent citizen & pledged to prosecute this clear attempt to doxx and target an American under Texas Penal Code § 37.08 (making a false allegation to your office)?" Shukla asked.According to her LinkedIn profile, Gollapudi is a senior graduate research assistant at the University of Texas at Austin. Her bachelor's was from the University of Houston. Her Instagram profile lists her as a biomedical engineer and a Kuchipudi dancer.Gollapudi reacted to the controversy and said the past few days were extremely difficult and upsetting. "My content has been reposted without my permission on another social media platform (X) by an account that is spreading false and misleading claims about me," she wrote in an Instagram post.
Article Summary: Sadhana Gollapudi, an Indian-American woman, was accused of visa fraud. A popular anti-Indian social media account posted a dancing video of Sadhana and claimed that she had been in the US on an F-1 visa since 2014. The US attorney confirmed that she is a naturalized US citizen. The incident triggered a massive backlash from the Indian-Americans.

Article Title: Indian expat from Kerala killed in Dubai gas cylinder blast; colleague recalls moments before explosion
Article Text:
Shijin Paul/Image: X

Colleague recounts fire before blast

Explosion struck during firefighting efforts

An Indian-origin man from Kerala was killed in a gas cylinder explosion at a car showroom on Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai on Monday, the Indian Consulate in Dubai confirmed, Gulf News reported.The victim was identified as Shijin Paul, 27, from Kottarakkara in Kerala's Kollam district.A relative told the outlet that Shijin succumbed to his injuries at a hospital after the explosion."I was informed by his company about the blast. Unfortunately, he had passed away by the time I reached the hospital," the relative said.Shijin worked as the showroom's multimedia marketing specialist, handling social media and videography. According to his family, he had joined the company in November. He is survived by his parents and wife.A co-worker who witnessed the incident said employees rushed outside after colleagues noticed a fire on the premises."Some of us, including Shijin and I, went out of our showroom after some of our colleagues alerted us about a fire," Abid, a photographer who worked with Shijin, told the newspaper."There were people from several shops nearby too, not just from our showroom.Many people came running after spotting the fire."Abid said the flames appeared to have broken out near a gate close to neighbouring auto service workshops."There is a gate in one corner of the showroom, and the fire started somewhere there. There are some auto service companies next to our showroom, and the fire was near their location."According to Abid, people at the scene attempted to contain the fire with extinguishers before the cylinder exploded."People were trying to put out the fire with fire extinguishers. The explosion occurred while efforts were underway to douse the fire. Everyone ran away," he said.He added that he did not immediately realise Shijin had been caught in the blast."I don't know who all got hit. I got to know about his death later," Abid said.The Indian Consulate said it remains in contact with Shijin's family and the authorities to provide support following the incident.
Article Summary: Shijin Paul, 27, from Kottarakkara in Kerala's Kollam district, died in the blast. He worked as the showroom's multimedia marketing specialist, handling social media and videography. A co-worker who witnessed the incident said employees rushed outside after colleagues noticed a fire on the premises.

Article Title: Delhi Mosque Demolition: Delhi Demolition Drive Near Faiz-e-Elahi Mosque: Police Clash During MCD Action
Article Text:
Delhi demolition drive: MCD carries out action near Faiz-e-Elahi mosque following HC order; 5 cops injured in stone pelting

Delhi: 5 Cops Injured, 10 Detained As Anti-Encroachment Drive Near Mosque Turns Violent

Demolition drive at Faiz-e-Ilahi Mosque near Turkman Gate in Delhi on Wednesday. Image Credit: Tarun Rawat/TNN







NEW DELHI: Multiple police personnel were injured during a demolition drive in central Delhi early on Wednesday after locals and miscreants attacked them with stones.The police is trying to identify the miscreants who engaged in stone-pelting and will initiate strict action against them.Delhi Police have registered an FIR against unknown persons and around 10 people have been detained for questioning so far, officials said.Police are scanning CCTV footage, ground visuals and body-camera recordings to identify those involved in the attack on the police team.While the FIR has been lodged against unidentified persons, investigators said four to five suspects have already been identified and further legal action will follow.Special commissioner (Law and Order) Ravindra Yadav said that the action started around 1 am."MCD conducted demolition as per the high court's orders on the encroached land. Stones were pelted at the police at night. We used minimal force to push back."DCP (Central) Nidhin Valsan said, "The action is still ongoing. We deployed our staff for security. 4 to 5 officers suffered minor injuries. As soon as we get the CCTV camera footage, ground footage, and body camera footage, we will identify the miscreants and take legal action."The demolition was carried out by the MCD to remove illegal constructions around the Faiz-e-Ilahi Mosque in the Turkman Gate area. The drive kicked off around 1 am, with around 17 bulldozers pressed into service.The action followed an order of the Delhi High Court, which declared a dispensary and a community hall adjoining the mosque illegal and directed their removal.The administration appealed to local residents to maintain peace.Anticipating major disruptions, the Delhi Traffic Police also issued a traffic advisory, warning of congestion on several key roads on Wednesday. Traffic around Ramlila Maidan and adjoining areas is expected to remain affected through the day.
Article Summary: 5 cops injured in stone pelting during demolition drive in central Delhi. Police are trying to identify the miscreants who engaged in stone-pelting. The demolition was carried out by MCD to remove illegal constructions around the Faiz-e-Ilahi Mosque in the Turkman Gate area.

Article Title: Laxmi Nagar assault: New clip shows SUV crashing into house; accused Omkar Yadav claims self-defence in viral video
Article Text: NEW DELHI: Another CCTV clip related to the Laxmi Nagar assault has surfaced, showing a group of men arriving first, opening a gate and assaulting a man. Moments later, a Thar SUV was seen speeding towards the house and crashing into the wall, after which several men got out of it and the assault continued. Meanwhile, accused Omkar Yadav has released a video on social media defending his brother, gym caretaker and key accused Satish Yadav alias Pintu Yadav.A dispute over a gym operating from a residential property in east Delhi's Laxmi Nagar allegedly escalated into the assault recently when the man was beaten up, his wife was said to be molested, and their son was stripped and assaulted on the street.The man runs a gym from the basement of his house and caretaker Yadav allegedly cheated him and attempted to take over the business, leading to the dispute. On Jan 2, during an argument over a basement- and sewage-related issue, Yadav, along with his associates, assaulted the couple and their son, a senior officer said.An earlier CCTV footage had shown the couple's son being dragged onto the road, stripped and beaten up by a group of four-five men. The presence of police personnel in parts of the footage also raised questions. Police claimed the assault stopped after they arrived while the victims alleged that they were beaten up in full view of the cops, a claim that is being verified.According to the complaint, the couple's son came out after hearing the commotion and was assaulted. The couple also said their two sons had left the house following the attack.Police said main accused Yadav was arrested while the other accused were absconding. Omkar, one of the absconding accused, posted a video on social media, saying his brother had been working with the complainant for "20-25 years" and was running the gym for the past "12-13 years". He questioned why objections over the gym were raised only in the past five-six months. "If we captured the land, why did she start complaining only now?" he asked.Omkar further alleged that the legal proceedings were "one-sided" and claimed that he was also being targeted. He identified himself as a worker of a party and alleged that he was being defamed by an opposition party.Referring to the incident, Omkar said, "On Jan 2, I got a call from my brother. I reached the spot after 10-15 minutes. If I am seen kicking two or three times in the video, it was in self-defence. They started hitting first."A case has been registered at the Laxmi Nagar police station under various provisions of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, including voluntarily causing hurt, wrongful restraint, criminal trespass, assault or use of criminal force to outrage the modesty of a woman, acts intended to insult a woman's modesty and criminal intimidation.
Article Summary: A dispute over a gym operating from a residential property in east Delhi's Laxmi Nagar allegedly escalated into the assault. The man runs a gym from the basement of his house and caretaker Yadav allegedly cheated him and attempted to take over the business. On Jan 2, during an argument over a basement- and sewage- related issue, Yadav along with his associates, assaulted the couple and their son.

Article Title: Rahul Gandhi reveals his favourite BJP leader in candid Gen Z 'Ask Me Anything' on Instagram
Article Text:
Rahul Gandhi launched an Instagram "Ask Me Anything" session for young people





NEW DELHI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Thursday launched an "Ask Me Anything" session on Instagram as part of a fresh outreach to Gen Z, responding to questions on student protests, women's education, politics and even lighter topics such as Batman.Sharing the initiative on X, the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha wrote, "Students, Gen-Z -- I'm here to listen. Ask me anything on Instagram, and I'll answer as many questions as I can." The Congress later shared video clips of his responses.Responding to a question on the ongoing student agitation in Jharkhand over alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations, Gandhi said the country's education system had "collapsed" and urged governments across party lines to pay attention to students' concerns."The student protests that are happening in the country are against the education system. I have said it in Kota, Dehradun and will say it in Allahabad that our education system has collapsed. It is unaffordable and oppressive," Gandhi said."Every government, whether it is the Centre, a Congress government or the Jharkhand government, should listen to what students are saying and take action to change the education system," he added.The protest in Jharkhand entered its 13th day on Thursday, with six demonstrators continuing an indefinite hunger strike. Student groups have formed an 11-member delegation for talks with the state government over their demands.Asked what message he had for young women fighting for their right to education, Gandhi said women deserved equal — if not greater — space in every sphere of life."India's women are our biggest strength. I do not appreciate the way women are treated in society, in our education system or in the corporate sector. You be confident, you be brave, you be powerful exactly as you are, and we are there to fully support you," he said.In one of the lighter moments of the interaction, Gandhi was asked to name his favourite politician from the BJP. He named former Punjab chief minister Captain Amarinder Singh, saying they got along well and praising his knowledge of military history.On the state of education, Gandhi alleged that the system was "busy destroying thinkers" and claimed that after being "captured" by the RSS, its focus had shifted to discouraging independent thinking among young people.Asked if he was Batman, Gandhi joked, "Let's just say that no one has ever seen me and Batman in the same room together."Replying to a question on the philosophy that inspires him the most, Gandhi referred to the ideas of Lord Buddha, Guru Nanak Dev, Basavanna, Sankardev, Birsa Munda, Periyar, Mahatma Phule, Narayana Guru, B R Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi, among others, saying these traditions had shaped India's Constitution.The Instagram interaction came a day after Gandhi met students who had protested over the NEET paper leak and allegedly faced police action last month. On Wednesday, he accused Union home minister Amit Shah of being responsible for the violence against the protesters and claimed the government had failed to explain the incident in Parliament.Gandhi has increasingly been using Instagram to engage with students and young voters. The platform has emerged as a key battleground for political outreach, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union ministers and leaders across parties also stepping up their engagement with Gen Z audiences.(With PTI inputs)
Article Summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi launched an "Ask Me Anything" session on Instagram. He responded to questions on student protests, women's education, politics and even lighter topics. Gandhi has increasingly been using Instagram to engage with students and young voters. The platform has emerged as a key battleground for political outreach.

Article Title: NTA's own experts leaked NEET-UG papers for cash, CBI chargesheet alleges
Article Text:
The CBI has filed a chargesheet naming thirteen individuals in a paper leak conspiracy.





NEW DELHI: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has concluded that the alleged NEET-UG 2026 paper leak was the result of a well-coordinated, multi-state criminal conspiracy in which confidential question papers were leaked by National Testing Agency (NTA) subject experts and circulated through a network of middlemen to candidates in return for large sums of money.In a chargesheet filed before the Special CBI Court at Delhi's Rouse Avenue, the agency has named 13 accused, including three NTA-appointed subject experts, alleging they exploited their official roles to illegally access the examination papers before the test and pass them on through a chain of intermediaries.The three experts named are Botany specialist Manisha Gurunath Mandhare, Chemistry expert Prahlad Vithalrao Kulkarni and Physics expert Manisha Sanjay Havaldar. According to the CBI, they leaked confidential NEET-UG 2026 questions, which were subsequently circulated among coaching operators and brokers before reaching candidates.The accused have been booked under provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), the Prevention of Corruption Act and the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024.The agency said its investigation uncovered a well-defined supply chain linking the NTA experts to middlemen and coaching operators who allegedly distributed the leaked papers to candidates for money.Apart from the three NTA experts, the chargesheet names Tejas Shah, Shivraj Motegaonkar, Dr Manoj Shirure, Manisha Sanjay Waghmare, Dhananjay Lokhande, Shubham Khairnar, Yash Yadav, Mangilal Biwal, Dinesh Biwal and Vikas Biwal. The CBI alleged that each played a specific role in facilitating the leak, coordinating candidates or handling financial transactions.According to the chargesheet, forensic examination of seized mobile phones, pen drives and other electronic devices recovered PDF and image files containing leaked NEET-UG 2026 questions. Investigators alleged that the files were exchanged through Telegram, WhatsApp and other messaging applications several days before the examination.The CBI claimed that digital evidence helped reconstruct the route through which the leaked papers moved across multiple states and accused.The agency alleged that Mangilal Biwal received the leaked questions from co-accused Yash Yadav via Telegram. As part of the arrangement, Biwal allegedly handed over his original Class X and XII certificates along with a signed blank cheque as security to one of Yadav's associates. These documents were later recovered during searches, the chargesheet said.Investigators further alleged that Yash Yadav sourced the papers from Nashik-based accused Shubham Khairnar. Forensic analysis of Yadav's mobile phone reportedly uncovered chats with a contact saved as "AP Broker", identified as Khairnar, along with PDF files containing the leaked question paper.The CBI alleged that Khairnar paid Rs 25 lakh to Dhananjay Lokhande for the leaked paper. During questioning, Khairnar is said to have disclosed details of the financial transaction. Lokhande, in turn, allegedly received the leaked papers from Manisha Sanjay Waghmare, who arranged for physical copies to be delivered through intermediaries.Searches at Waghmare's residence allegedly led to the recovery of a mobile phone containing a WhatsApp group named "NEET 2026", which investigators believe was used in connection with the conspiracy.The agency also alleged that Waghmare was in touch with NTA Chemistry expert Prahlad Kulkarni, who had worked on the Marathi-to-English back translation of the Chemistry paper. According to the CBI, Waghmare obtained leaked Biology and Chemistry questions through students she had introduced to Mandhare and Kulkarni.The chargesheet also refers to statements recorded from candidates during the investigation. In one instance, a candidate and her father were allegedly offered access to the NEET-UG 2026 question paper for Rs 4 lakh, along with coaching support and offline revision classes conducted by one of the NTA subject experts. The CBI said these interactions took place between late 2025 and early 2026 as part of the broader conspiracy.The agency said forensic analysis of seized electronic devices, chat records, recovered documents and witness statements collectively supports its allegations of criminal conspiracy, abuse of official position by public servants and the illegal circulation of confidential examination material ahead of the NEET-UG 2026 examination.
Article Summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has concluded that the alleged NEET-UG 2026 paper leak was the result of a well-coordinated, multi-state criminal conspiracy. The agency has named 13 accused, including three NTA-appointed subject experts, alleging they exploited their official roles to illegally access the papers.

Article Title: CJP announces leadership line-up: Abhijeet Dipke takes charge as convener, check who gets what post
Article Text:
The announcement followed a two-day meeting of the CJP core team, where the party also named chief spokesperson Saurav Das and spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka as co-conveners

Who Gets What: CJP's National Working Committee Line-Up

CJP's Expansion Roadmap





NEW DELHI: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has announced its National Working Committee as part of efforts to strengthen its organisational framework, with founder Abhijeet Dipke appointed as the National Convener.The announcement followed a two-day meeting of the CJP core team, where the party also named chief spokesperson Saurav Das and spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka as Co-Conveners, along with assigning responsibilities to other key members.The newly formed committee will oversee the party’s expansion strategy, including the formation of state coordination committees, Lok Sabha-level units, and city-level teams across the country in the next six months, the CJP said.Abhijeet Dipke (30) — Founder & National ConvenerSaurav Das (27) — Co-ConvenerAshutosh Ranka (30) — Co-ConvenerAjinkya Shinde (35) — National Organisation In-ChargeDeepak Baliyan (26) — Organisation Co-In-Charge & North Zone LeadAafreen Nawaz (34) — National SecretaryRatna Singh (31) — Legal Affairs LeadVaishnavi Gaur (29) — Research & Policy LeadRohan Deshpande (31) — Technology LeadVijay Reddi Mallangi (30) — Media LeadYogesh Ingale (33) — Finance & West Zone LeadAnkit Bhardwaj (35) — East & North East Zone LeadCJP said it will launch a membership drive through its website, inviting students, young professionals and workers to join the organisation.The outfit clarified that it is not collecting any funds as part of the membership campaign.The organisation also reiterated that it has no immediate plans to enter electoral politics. "Adding one more political party will not be useful at this time. We will work at the grassroots level," CJP spokesperson Saurav Das said."We are launching a membership drive through our website. Students, young professionals and workers can join us to raise their voices unitedly, " Saurav Das told PTI.Meanwhile, CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka said a delegation will visit student protesters in Jharkhand, where an agitation over alleged recruitment exam irregularities has entered its 13th day. Six demonstrators are currently on hunger strike.
Article Summary: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has announced its National Working Committee as part of efforts to strengthen its organisational framework. The newly formed committee will oversee the party’s expansion strategy, including the formation of state coordination committees, Lok Sabha-level units, and city-level teams across the country in the next six months.

Article Title: Three injured as plaster falls from ceiling at BEST’s Majas depot
Article Text:
The incident occurred in a store room-cum-rest area for staffers

Mumbai:





Three BEST bus mechanics were injured after a portion of a ceiling slab collapsed inside a storeroom allotted to a wet-lease contractor in the engineering department at Majas depot on Thursday, raising serious concerns over the structural safety of several ageing depot buildings across Mumbai. The incident occurred in a store room-cum-rest area for staffers.According to sources, one employee sustained serious injuries and required stitches, while two others suffered minor injuries and were discharged after receiving medical attention. The incident occurred during working hours and could have proved far more serious had more personnel been present inside the room at the time, sources said.A BEST spokesperson said the incident occurred at 6.45 a.m. when sections of plaster from the slab collapsed inside the facility used by the operator’s engineering department staff. The injured workers were identified as Riyan Shaikh (19), Salman Khan (23) and Mujamdin Khan (20). The spokesperson said the injured were treated at the hospital and are reported to be in stable condition. Further assessment of the affected structure is expected to be carried out to ensure safety and prevent any recurrence of such incidents, the spokesperson added.The mishap has triggered fresh criticism of BEST’s infrastructure maintenance practices, with Shiv Sena (UBT) nominee on the BEST committee, Nitin Nandgaonkar, demanding immediate accountability from the undertaking’s civil department. “Apart from demanding an immediate structural audit of all depots in Mumbai, I will demand suspension of officials from the civil department for negligence. Accountability must be fixed before a more serious tragedy occurs,” he said.Nandgaonkar said he had personally inspected several depots earlier this year and found many structures to be in poor condition. Following these visits, he wrote to the BEST administration in March seeking urgent intervention as severa depots required immediate repairs and some appeared structurally unsafe.Questioning the pace of repairs under BEST’s ongoing infrastructure modernisation and “Kayapalat” initiative, he said employees were being forced to work under unsafe conditions. “A depot is a workplace. Staffers should not have to fear for their lives while on duty. Are authorities waiting for such incidents to recur before acting?” he asked.The collapse has renewed demands for a city-wide assessment of BEST’s ageing depot infrastructure, with employee representatives and committee members calling for urgent repairs and safety certification of buildings used daily by thousands of workers and contractors.Ends
Article Summary: A portion of a ceiling slab collapsed inside a storeroom allotted to a wet-lease contractor in the engineering department at Majas depot on Thursday. The incident occurred during working hours and could have proved far more serious had more personnel been present inside the room at the time, sources said. The mishap has triggered fresh criticism of BEST’s infrastructure maintenance practices.

Article Title: Prashant Kishor meets NCP chief Sunetra Pawar after bypoll poll win, BJP upset
Article Text:
Prashant Kishor met NCP leaders Sunetra and Parth Pawar after his recent election victory.





MUMBAI: Jan Suraaj party founder and prominent political strategist Prashant Kishor , who won the Bankipur bypoll in Bihar this week after defeating the BJP , called on the deputy chief minister Sunetra Pawar from the NCP and her MP son Parth Pawar, on Thursday. This is the second time Kishor is meeting them in three months, raising questions about whether they want him to become the party's political advisor.The meeting has upset the BJP, the NCP's alliance partner in the government, which says it is inappropriate for a constituent of the NDA to engage with an opponent of the BJP. The BJP was especially unhappy about the meeting taking place so soon after Kishor won the bypoll at the long-held BJP bastion Bankipur."We cannot be fighting elections together on one hand while simultaneously engaging a strategist who has built his recent political identity around defeating the BJP," said a BJP functionary."One meeting may be dismissed as a courtesy call. Repeated closed-door discussions naturally raise questions," the BJP functionary added.During the 2024 assembly polls, the NCP's strategy was crafted by Design Box, but they later parted ways. This has raised questions about whether Kishor will become the party's next political strategist.However, after their meeting in May, Parth Pawar had denied this on X, saying Kishor was a close family friend. "To the best of my knowledge, it has been a few years since he has quit the political advisory space. I don't see that changing but I can assure all those who are interested that we are and will always be available to each other whenever needed," he had said.
Article Summary: Prashant Kishor won the Bankipur bypoll in Bihar this week after defeating the BJP. He called on the deputy chief minister Sunetra Pawar from the NCP and her MP son Parth Pawar. This is the second time he is meeting them in three months.
